newsitem.title: USA: First Federal Bancshares to be acquired.
newsitem.headline: First Federal Bancshares to be acquired.

text.p: First Federal Bancshares of Eau Claire Inc said Monday it entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by Mutual Savings Bank of Milwaukee, Wis., in a $132 million transaction.
First Federal said its stockholders will receive $18.85 a share in cash.

First Federal said the purchase price represents a 33 percent premium over its June 30, 1996, per share book value. First Federal went public in October 1994, at an initial offering price of $10 a share.

The company said the transaction, which was approved by the board of directors, is expected to close during the first quarter of 1997. The deal is subject to First Federal shareholder approval, regulatory approvals and various other conditions.
First Federal has about $707 million in assets. The acquisition will make Mutual Savings the second largest savings bank chartered by Wisconsin, with over $1.9 billion in assets.
